Name: Loy Krathong Festival (Thai Festival)
Author: ppokpong
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55997/55997-1795563993-1857274929.png[/img]

[i]Gather by the water, make a wish, and watch the lights drift into the night.[/i]

[youtube]gCl9VeT1AXY[/youtube][/center]

[size=5][b]A night to remember[/b][/size]
Bring Thailand's Loy Krathong festival to Stardew Valley. From [b]6:00 PM to midnight[/b], the Beach comes alive with food stalls, glowing lights, villagers and krathongs floating across the water.

By default, the festival follows the full moon of the 12th Thai lunar month, using the corresponding day in Fall (Fall 24 in 2026). You can choose another date in the settings.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55997/55997-1795564036-1870736800.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Explore the festival[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]A festive Beach[/b] — Visit Gus's Thai food stall and Caroline's krathong stall, decorate a krathong, and find the Nang Noppamas stage beneath warm Night Market lights. Villagers stroll, chat and react to you.[/*]
[*][b]Float a krathong[/b] — Buy, craft or decorate banana-leaf and bread krathongs. Make a wish, simply set one afloat, or tuck in 10g for luck. Visit the Beach, town river, mountain lake, Forest or Ginger Island once you've visited it. Walk into the water, press once to pick up a krathong, and walk back out.[/*]
[*][b]Festival cutscenes[/b] — Enjoy a welcome on the Beach, the Nang Noppamas pageant, and the grand release at [b]9:00 PM[/b], when Lewis gathers everyone at the pier to float their krathongs together.[/*]
[*][b]Nang Noppamas pageant[/b] — Contestants dress in traditional outfits with sabai, pha sin and a small gold crown. You can enter and change too. The score combines judges (50), NPC votes (30) and player votes (20).[/*]
[*][b]Run your own booth[/b] — Lewis invites you about a week before the festival. Give him at least five krathongs, then sell them in a minigame as villagers request a colour or base shape. Co-op is supported.[/*]
[*][b]Taste Thai treats[/b] — Enjoy khanom thuai, mango sticky rice, moo ping and coconut water.[/*]
[*][b]More to discover[/b] — Rent Willy's little boat, clean up bread krathongs, relight a villager's candle, or catch a rare glimpse of Phra Mae Khongkha on the water. Taking money from someone else's krathong has consequences: witnesses react, rumours spread and you'll have a day of bad luck.[/*]
[*][b]Letters and reminders[/b] — Receive Lewis's invitation and a krathong recipe, a reminder the day before, and a thank-you letter. A small krathong marks the festival on the calendar.[/*]
[*][b]Ginger Island[/b] — The island gets dark on festival night, just like the valley.[/*]
[/list][center][size=5][b]Festival moments[/b][/size]
[i]A glimpse of the Beach, the pier and the lights on the water.[/i]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5+[/*]
[/list]No other mods are required.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the [b]LoyKrathong[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Settings:[/b] Press [b]F8[/b] or click the krathong on the calendar to change the season, day, Phra Mae Khongkha's chance and effects.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] Detected automatically; tested with 1.15.11.[/*]
[*][b]Co-op:[/b] Every player needs the mod. The host controls the date, payouts and pageant.[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher:[/b] Content goes through the content pipeline, so Content Patcher packs can edit it.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Thai language · ภาษาไทย[/b][/size]
Thai translations are included. The vanilla font does not contain Thai letters, so install [b]Stardew Valley - THAI[/b] and [b]Thai Font Adjuster[/b], then select Thai in the game's language options.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Thanks to ConcernedApe and the SMAPI team. Dialogue was written with GPT.

Downloads.Description: Full Loy Krathong festival: beach venue with Night Market, krathong floating, pier release cutscene, pageant, your own booth, and Thai/English dialogue. Requires SMAPI 4.5+ and Stardew Valley 1.6.14+. Extract the LoyKrathong folder into Mods.
